description_addition: The taxa list preserves the eight independently grounded species and strain annotations in the MetaCyc 27.0 parent pathway. These native species slots have no individual evidence entries; the parent direct-assay citation concerns PKO1 and does not demonstrate the complete route in every listed organism. Historical native Pseudomonas putida mt-2 (ORG-5948) remains strain context without a guessed modern taxon alias. Component-source organisms and recombinant expression hosts are not added as whole-route taxa.
